about: What the speaker does to a box over a window: speaker_track.Track.samples_in / overlap / head_clear / cover on two synthetic tracks (a 160x288 letterboxed frame, masks at 1/8, a hand up at two samples, a head lost at one; the second with a jump cut and a sample either side of it). cover: clear | near (she covers more than 3 %) | over (her grown head).
